viewHints.pick: Pull the card on top, then the next one. Cards follow where they're stored, so you pass each shelf once. For a whole box, use Pull with sorter.

viewHints.focus: One card at a time, big and easy to read. Mark it picked or skip it. Handy on a phone.
viewHints.box: Go through one storage box at a time and see every card in it. Pull the highlighted cards, or use Pull with sorter to let the sorter find them.

viewHints.sortWithSorter: Divide the cards you pulled into one pile per order. Each block lists the cards for that order's pile. Or use Split with sorter to let the sorter do it.
